newsitem.title: USA: NY Fed's McDonough says U.S. inflation is not dead.
newsitem.headline: NY Fed's McDonough says U.S. inflation is not dead.

text.p: Federal Reserve Bank of New York president William McDonough said it would be a mistake to conclude U.S. inflation is dead due to its recent tame behavior.

"It is very, very important that nobody, but especially central bankers, falls into the wonderful world of make-believe that inflation is dead. It is clearly not," McDonough said to investors gathered in New York.
He cautioned against any pre-emptive strike against perceived signs of inflation.

"The fact that you are concerned about the gorilla of inflation does not mean that every time you see a shadow that you shoot at it because you might shoot some poor soul who is just trying to find a job and it isn't the gorilla at all," he said.
